discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in `1544b995b`. `suggestion()` in `candidates.ts` now clips `prompt` to `PROMPT_MAX_CHARS` and `why` to `WHY_MAX_CHARS` before it hashes the id, so rule, model and turn rows all stay inside the published bounds. Text within the limits is unchanged, so the `host-rules.json` parity fixtures keep their ids. `contracts.test.ts` builds rows from a long task title, a status headline and a failing check list, and validates the set and push against `NextTurnSet` and `NextTurnTrayPush`.

Fixed in 202642e: parseStatus now keeps the original path on R/C records (originalPath on the file entry). The webview includes it in unstage actions (unstagePaths helper, used for row, group, and breadcrumb unstage) and passes it to get_git_file_diff so a staged rename reads HEAD at the old path. Covered by a real-repo test that git mv's a file, checks the diff shows the old contents, unstages both paths, and verifies the old path is no longer staged as a deletion.
Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.

Fixed. The matcher now accepts `false`, `False`, and `FALSE`, the three spellings both js-yaml's JSON schema and the SDK's yaml parser read as boolean false (`no`/`off` stay strings in both, so they are correctly left alone). Test added.

Fixed. An entry whose value is an inline scalar, like `disabled: true` or `disabled: false # note`, is now a single line, so an indented comment after it stays with the author. Block scalars (`|`, `>`) and nested values still take their indented continuation lines with them. Test added for both disabling and re-enabling.
it strips every plural suffix so a Russian catalog missing `_few`/`_many` passes. the catalog is good today but nothing guards it.
agent: guarded in 3d7457208 — new test requires every plural group to carry exactly the locale's CLDR cardinal categories

Fair point. Switched to splitting on `path.sep` only (same approach as the SDK's workspace file-indexer), so POSIX filenames containing a literal backslash are left intact. Added a POSIX-only test for that case.
